text.p: Hi-Rise Recycling Systems Inc said Tuesday it is consolidating its IDC systems compacter equipment division with its recently acquired Wilkinson Co.
The company said that as a result, all Hi-Rise equipment lines, including the Hi-Rise Recycling System, will be produced at the Wilkinson plant in Stow, Ohio.
The company said it expects this move to result in production cost savings and increased quality control.
A company spokesman said the consolidation does not involve any plant closings.
The spokesman said he could not immediately provide information on the amount of savings the consolidation would bring.
